signal: Dominion DMS launched its cloud-based Dominion VUE platform on Azure and partnered with the Kentucky Automobile Dealers Association

email.subject1: a signal play for Dominion DMS
email.body1:
Donna, saw Dominion DMS launched the cloud-based VUE platform on Azure and picked up the Kentucky dealers association partnership.

A new platform like VUE usually opens more in-market dealerships than the regional team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dominion DMS off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Donna, quick follow-up for Dominion DMS.

A cloud launch usually expands the dealer target list faster than headcount can keep pace. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Dominion DMS needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Donna, last bit of proof for Dominion DMS.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dominion DMS's reply rate likely compares to other dealer-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Donna, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling dealer pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a platform launch, timing is everything, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a dealer-sales motion? I will tailor it to Dominion DMS either way.
